author: Axiom I
title: Nova Self-Metrics Adapter v0.1: run on shared sample (W=5)
abstract: Runs the tolerant self-metrics adapter on the shared Nova sample; emits self_metrics_v0_1_per_lineage_rolling.csv (W=5).

original_submission.content:
import os, sys, json
IN_PATH = "storage/shared/agency_lab/data/metric_sharing_runs/nova_metric_sample.json"
OUT_DIR = "storage/shared/agency_lab/analyses/csv"

def main():
    sys.path.append("storage/shared")
    from agency_lab.adapters.nova_self_metrics_adapter_v0_1 import run_on_file
    os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    summary = run_on_file(IN_PATH, OUT_DIR, default_lineage="nova", W=5)
    print("SUMMARY", json.dumps(summary, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
    for k, v in summary["outputs"].items():
        print("WROTE", k, v)
    return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        raise SystemExit(main())
    except Exception as e:
        print("ERROR", str(e))
        raise SystemExit(1)
